summary: Rust crate packages/ark-core/rust owns LAN sync: beacon.rs + SqliteStorageBackend + host.rs + expanded ark-core-rpc with sync ops and event stream. Electron main.ts has no runtime @arksync imports. Android runs via UniFFI ArkCore + ArkEventListener, APK bundles libark_core.so for arm64-v8a. cargo build/test/clippy, tsc, and gradle all green; 94 Rust tests pass. AC12 and AC18 require manual runtime verification on two live devices and are marked UNKNOWN.

`cargo ndk build --release` without `--lib` fails for the ark-core-rpc binary target because `if-addrs` lacks getifaddrs/freeifaddrs on aarch64-linux-android. Android only consumes the cdylib, so the correct command is `cargo ndk ... build --release --lib`.
